posts.text:
Friday, Nov 13: Toronto's streetcars lost 970 hours to delays, across all routes.

Slowest for its length: 511 Bathurst northbound. A typical 4.8 km trip lost 12 min (usually 11).
Smoothest: 507 Long Branch westbound, 13 min over 8.0 km (usually 12).

#TTC #TransitSky #DataViz

https://stuckin.to/

Friday's slowest spot: Southbound on York St, approaching Adelaide St West.
The average streetcar lost 2 min 49 s here (usually 1 min 43 s). Across 144 trips, that adds up to 6.8 hours.
This signal has no transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of York St around Adelaide St West, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the southbound stretch at Adelaide St West is highlighted, peaking at about 2 min 49 s lost per streetcar.

shot.title: York St southbound, approaching Adelaide St West
shot.sub: Friday, Nov 13: 2 min 49 s lost per streetcar · 144 trips

posts.text:
Most short-turned, Friday, Nov 13: 512 St Clair. 1 in 14 trips (27) were sent back before the end of the line, most after St Clair Ave West at Bathurst St East Side (eastbound, 10), instead of going on to St Clair Station.

Across all routes, 4% of trips were short-turned.
posts.alt: Map of the 512 St Clair route in the waits view: a column at each stop, taller and darker where riders waited longer than scheduled, and yellow warning signs where cars were short-turned. A tooltip on the busiest spot, after St Clair Ave West at Bathurst St East Side, gives how many eastbound cars were sent back there instead of going on to St Clair Station.

posts.text:
Most held at a signal, Friday, Nov 13: eastbound at Fort York Blvd & Fleet St.

40% of streetcars waited 90 s or more beyond a clean approach, about a full signal cycle, despite transit priority.
About 282 streetcars came through.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Fort York Blvd & Fleet St, with arrows for each direction of streetcar travel into each signal, coloured by how often streetcars were held 90 seconds or more. A tooltip for the eastbound approach reads 40% held 90 s+, with a histogram of extra time through the approach.

posts.text:
Friday, Nov 13: at the busiest moment (5:10 pm), 150 streetcars were in service, against 151 scheduled.
Overall, 99% of scheduled streetcar service ran, and buses ran 1,040 hours on streetcar routes.
posts.alt: Line chart of streetcars in service through Friday, Nov 13, every 10 minutes from 4 am, against the TTC's schedule (dashed). The busiest moment was 150 streetcars at 5:10 pm, against 151 scheduled; over the day 99% of scheduled streetcar hours ran.

posts.text:
Longest extra wait at a stop, Friday, Nov 13: 2155 Lake Shore Blvd West (507 Long Branch eastbound).

Riders waited 11.0 min on average, against 5.0 if cars had come as scheduled: 6.0 min extra. 18% of cars came bunched, and 13 of 100 scheduled cars never came.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around 2155 Lake Shore Blvd West in the waits view, a column at each stop. A tooltip for the stop reads 6.0 minutes of excess wait, with how often cars came bunched or with gaps, and a chart of the spread of gaps between cars.
